items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I just remember now, see. Mm-hmm. Well, he broke up to the band he had, you see. He went to Tom Anderson on the boat. It was one of the other.

ctx.x: So you were with Buddy a real short length of time. Short length of time, yeah. I wouldn't say it was about too long. Oh, what about Armstrong? You said you played with him at Lollars? Yeah. And you played a lot of little parties with him?

A little, very few. I didn't play many. See, because I left, you see. I must play about one or two, because I left, you see. After we played Pete Lollars, after that 1916, you know, rave. Well, we went in Pete Lollars, you see, about 17 and the war started, come out, you know, broke out. Mm-hmm. And, uh, well, I didn't play, but he went on the boat, I think, or Tom Anderson's one of the two. I just remember now, see. Mm-hmm. Well, he broke up to the band he had, you see.
